title: Natural adventurer life — people, agreements, personalities and a living world (NPC E2/E3, PULSE A/C/B)
brief: Start a genuine Level-1 campaign and live an ordinary adventurer's career. Guild contracts are your backbone: register, choose achievable contracts from the actual board, do them and turn them in, and talk naturally with Guild staff and other adventurers. Bring the world's people into your play: get to know them, talk about their work and lives; when you meet someone again, greet them as someone you know and take up what you talked about, agreed or went through together, without re-asking things for the sake of it. Keep your promises; ask about promises made to you when it fits. When it makes sense, travel with someone, offer help or ask a capable person to join a contract; a party forms only if they credibly agree, and it is neither required nor a guaranteed success. React to new people and encounters on your own: friendly, curious, careful, suspicious or hostile as their conduct and your interests suggest. Negotiating, refusing, walking away and fighting are all real options; not everyone is your friend, not every conflict needs a fight, and people may say no. Explore towns, roads and the wild, and a dungeon if a contract or rumour leads there and you feel ready; rest, sleep at night and deal with what happens on the way. Let relationships grow on their own; never force them by repeating a conversation. You decide only your own actions and words: never what others say, feel or decide, what you will meet, find or achieve, and never ask the story for an event. No forced fights, scripted routes or invented accomplishments; trust the System results.

milestones.goal: Create a genuine Level-1 character through the ordinary creation menu; choose your own two starter skills.
Find the Adventurers' Guild and register as a member when you want to take contracts.
Finish a Guild contract you chose and turn it in at a Guild hall.
If a contract or a rumour leads you to a dungeon and you feel ready, go in and explore its first level.
Keep living this adventurer's life — contracts, people, travel, rest and whatever comes — for the whole run (about 70 inputs); there is no level target.

focus: Whether people you met before recognise you and remember what you talked about, agreed or went through together; notice it, do not test it with repeated questions.
Whether people keep their own character and goals, also when they disagree with you.
Whether roads, towns, the wild and your rests feel alive and fit place and time; react to it, never ask for events.
Contradictions between story, System panels and HUD (who is present, what was agreed, where you are, what you hold).
personas: warm, curious and sociable: you seek out people, ask about their work and lives and follow up on it later; you readily offer help or ask capable people to come along, and accept a refusal gracefully; you still judge people by how they act and keep your guard up with anyone who threatens you

wary and pragmatic: polite but guarded with strangers, you ask questions before you trust, haggle, decline offers that seem off, keep the promises you make and expect the same; you work with people who prove reliable, avoid or stand up to those who do not, and prefer scouting to needless fights
